# Error Handling Checklist: Attribution Foundation

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and failure coverage of the Attribution Foundation requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: Guarded-defect diagnostics, both directions of credit-header proof, missing inputs, malformed JSON, and frontmatter placement.
**Depth**: Standard; reviewer use during planning and PR review.

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist error-handling` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines its requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirement-quality approval; it does not mean implementation work is complete.
